comments.text: A little-endian pointer to the eight-page source copied to RAM beneath I/O by $34DD and $717C.
Row stride in bytes: the scroll code at $2D35 and $2D62 adds this value to the map source pointer.
The rightward-scroll check at $0EF7–$0F02 compares the next map-column position with this value.
The downward-scroll check at $0CCC–$0CD9 compares the next map-row position with this value.
The little-endian address $9AB7 of this load’s entity records. $1863 copies it into the pointer at $E2–$E3.
The initial entity-slot limit is 1. The initializer at $186D uses this value while loading records; later records can be selected by the slot-reuse path at $3632.

A 256-byte lookup indexed by screen character value. The resident code at $6F59–$6F5F reads a character from the selected screen buffer and writes the corresponding table byte to colour RAM. The table continues across $8000.
Continuation of the character-to-colour lookup beginning at $7FCF; this byte is entry $31 of that table, and entries continue through $80CE.

A 256-byte attribute table indexed by the map's metatile value. The downward movement check at $0C57 tests bits 0–1, and the horizontal movement checks at $0EB8 and $1051 test bit 1 when clipping the player against a tile.
A 256-byte table of top-left character codes indexed by a metatile value. The resident draw loop at $6D4D writes the selected code to the first cell of a two-by-two screen block.
A 256-byte table of top-right character codes indexed by a metatile value. The resident draw loop at $6D53 writes the selected code to the cell to the right of the first cell.
A 256-byte table of bottom-left character codes indexed by a metatile value. The resident draw loop at $6D5A writes the selected code one 40-character screen row below the first cell.
A 256-byte table of bottom-right character codes indexed by a metatile value. The resident draw loop at $6D60 writes the selected code one row below and one cell to the right of the first cell.
